criteria.criterion: Navigate from Apple homepage to Apple Watch and open the Apple Watch Series page
criteria.final_justification: The agent did reach and open a bona fide Apple Watch Series product page (Series 11) on apple.com. Locale overlays appear in some states, but they don’t negate that the Series page itself was opened. Baseline stands.

criteria.criterion: Open the Apple Watch SE page
criteria.final_justification: The agent opened the Apple Watch SE 3 page on apple.com (even though a region chooser overlay appears in some states). Baseline stands.

criteria.criterion: Compare starting prices for Apple Watch Series vs Apple Watch SE
criteria.final_justification: The core starting prices ($399 for Series 11; $249 for SE 3) are explicitly supported in DOM. However, the agent additionally claimed an education price “from $229,” which Reality Notes/applicable evidence say is not evidenced. Deduct minor points for including unsupported extra pricing detail while still correctly providing the required starting prices and comparison.

criteria.criterion: Compare available case sizes for Apple Watch Series vs Apple Watch SE
criteria.final_justification: Agent’s SE 3 sizes (40mm/44mm) are supported. Agent’s Series 11 sizes (41mm/45mm) are not supported by the provided DOM evidence set, so the full comparison is unproven under the DOM rule. Award partial credit for correctly extracting SE sizes and attempting comparison without DOM support for Series sizes.

criteria.criterion: Compare stated battery life for Apple Watch Series vs Apple Watch SE
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not report the explicitly evidenced Series 11 figure (“up to 24 hours”), and instead gave generic ‘great battery life/all-day’ language plus outside-knowledge-style statements. SE 3 battery life is not evidenced in DOM here, so a direct comparison cannot be confirmed. Partial credit for at least engaging the Battery tab, but the reported comparison is not DOM-supported and omits the Series 11 explicit statement.

criteria.criterion: Identify two health or safety features for Apple Watch Series
criteria.final_justification: Agent included at least two Series 11 health features (heart sensors/heart monitoring and wrist temperature sensing) that are DOM-supported. However, the agent also asserted specific safety features (Emergency SOS, Fall Detection, Crash Detection) for Series 11 without DOM support in the provided evidence. Still, since the criterion only requires two features and two are supported, award full credit.

criteria.criterion: Identify two health or safety features for Apple Watch SE
criteria.final_justification: At least two SE 3 health features are clearly and explicitly stated in DOM (temperature sensor/ovulation estimates; sleep score/sleep apnea notifications). Criterion satisfied regardless of extra unsupported safety-feature claims elsewhere.

criteria.criterion: Make a recommendation for a first-time smartwatch buyer (no purchase)
criteria.final_justification: The agent does provide a clear recommendation in text, but under the DOM rule the justification relies on multiple unproven/unsupported page facts (notably Series case sizes, SE battery life, and multiple named safety features). Some grounding exists (starting prices from Watch lineup are supported; SE health features are supported), so award partial credit for a recommendation partially based on supported facts, but not fully meeting the requirement to ground it in all requested compared attributes.

criteria.criterion: Avoid purchasing or crossing transaction critical points
criteria.final_justification: No evidence of clicking ‘Buy’ or proceeding into configurator/checkout or entering personal/payment info. Agent stayed in information-gathering flow. Baseline stands.
